title: Understanding Silhouette Score
text: The silhouette score measures how similar a data point is to its own cluster compared to other clusters. A high silhouette score indicates that the data point is well matched to its own cluster and poorly matched to neighboring clusters.

title: Evaluating Clustering Outcomes
text: When evaluating clustering outcomes, consider both the compactness of clusters and the separation between different clusters.

title: Analyzing the Statement
text: Consider whether a high silhouette score implies that a data point is far from other points in its cluster.
